ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on planting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Stories of Prophets: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Taqwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Tawakkul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
